SELECT gm.id,g.owner_id, gm.group_id, gm.user_id, u.username, u.avatar, gm.role, gm.group_nick, gm.join_time, gm.leave_time, gm.leave_type, gm.status FROM cf_group_member gm JOIN cf_user u ON u.id = gm.user_id LEFT JOIN cf_group g ON g.id = gm.group_id WHERE gm.group_id = #{groupId} AND gm.status = 1
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
ORDER BY gm.role DESC, gm.join_time ASC, gm.id ASC
